scope: Evaluator-only authored ordinary reference baseline from the stipulated synthetic case. This incomplete archive is neither empirical evidence nor a recommended correct solution. Absence from it supports no global novelty inference.

families.plain_description: Resolve requested weeks using assignment history.
families.actor_operation_target: Engineer makes export course selection consult effective dates of instructor assignments for the requested week.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Historical selection prevents current assignments from silently excluding relevant weekly courses.
families.conditions: Keep private processing, the documented CSV schema, concurrent attendance entry, and the six-day budget.
families.assumptions: Historical assignment data exists or can be recovered accurately within the bounded change.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Use persistent course identifiers across name changes.
families.actor_operation_target: Engineer joins attendance and course records by stable identifiers and applies an explicit display-name rule.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Renaming a course no longer breaks selection through inconsistent text matches.
families.conditions: Preserve the required CSV columns and authorized center boundaries.
families.assumptions: Existing records expose usable identifiers and split-course relationships can be handled explicitly.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Provide a course-list preview and authorized repeat export.
families.actor_operation_target: Coordinator reviews the proposed week and course set before downloading and requests a fresh file through the private service.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Early confirmation catches omissions and self-service generation reduces replacement-file waiting.
families.conditions: Fit the engineering allowance and keep all files in authorized workspaces.
families.assumptions: Coordinators can recognize their intended course set and the existing exporter is safely reusable.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Check center and course completeness before making files available.
families.actor_operation_target: Exporter compares selected records with an authorized expected roster and rejects any row from another center.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Explicit membership checks expose missing courses and prevent cross-center rows reaching a download.
families.conditions: Checks must not block ordinary attendance entry or change the accepted schema.
families.assumptions: An expected roster can be defined reliably and center ownership is represented in the data.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Which coordinator steps account for handling time?
families.actor_operation_target: Analyst observes checking, correction, download, and spreadsheet import during consenting sessions.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Separate timings identify whether the main burden lies in export content or downstream handling.
families.conditions: Participant names stay within existing authorized environments.
families.assumptions: Observed work resembles normal weekly preparation.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Which source defines the intended course set for a requested week?
families.actor_operation_target: Analyst compares local schedules and service history around assignment changes, renames, and course splits.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Disagreements reveal stale schedules or differing inclusion rules before a selection fix is chosen.
families.conditions: Use fabricated participants for staging investigations.
families.assumptions: Coordinators can explain intended inclusion and records retain sufficient change history.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs
